about: The secreta of the formulary “Mass of the Easter Vigil” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

s01.translation: Accept, we beseech You, Lord, the prayers of Your people together with the offerings of sacrificial victims, so that what has been consecrated in the paschal mysteries may, through Your action, benefit us as a remedy for eternity. Through Jesus Christ, our Lord, Your Son, who, as God, lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit

alignments.gloss: what has been consecrated in the paschal mysteries
may benefit us as a remedy for eternity through Your action
who lives and reigns with You
in the unity of the Holy Spirit

w012.explanation: Initiata is a passive participle used as a neuter plural noun: “what has been consecrated”. It is the subject of proficiant.

w020.explanation: Ad medelam expresses the goal of healing or remedy, aeternitatis relates it to eternity, and nobis identifies the beneficiaries. Te operante describes God acting.

w037.explanation: Deus names Jesus Christ as God.
